summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Applied Finance IVS US SMID ETF (IVSS) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund of 150 small- to mid-cap companies in the US, believed to have superior return potential. The fund uses an Intrinsic Value Stewardship (IVS) analytical model to select its constituents. IVSS was launched on Dec 3, 2025 and is issued by Applied Finance.

holdings.infoBox: IVSS is an equity ETF with a total of 357 individual holdings. The top holdings are InterDigital stock at 1.87%, Sterling Infrastructure at 1.84%, Dave Inc. at 1.74%, HealthEquity at 1.59%, and Amneal Pharmaceuticals at 1.51%.
